task: Bounded D-B startup architecture investigation: at most two paths, hardware only
HEAD: b42c0e6284aac734fde851c69146abf73920f337
recommendation: Select whether qualified1.5A sources are acceptable, then close/capture the separated USB-main, current-limited BQ25173 charger, cap-fed TPS61023 boost architecture. No compatibility selection has been implemented.
path1: Retain500mA: TPS2553 output precharge + TPS259474 reverse-blocking bypass + TPS3808 voltage-qualified sequencer + raw-powered AON and separate EN states. Not closed because TPS61094 externally-prebiased handoff/current/config-time is not explicitly guaranteed; proposed additions also need completed circuit/timing/transient proof.
path2: CC-qualified1.5A via TUSB320LAI/CC3V3/POR/gates; TPS2553 22.1k main limit; TPS2116 USB/backup mux; hard-limited BQ25173 100mA charger branch; TPS61023 boost starts from cap while USB remains selected. Current/control allocations PASS, but guaranteed main startup, boost low-input limits/PFM maximum, CC timing, charge corners and thermal remain open.
product_contract: 500mA was a prior engineering choice, not an explicit owner requirement. Path2 rejects default USB sources for normal operation, requires correct barrel source-side CC advertisement, introduces detector -40..85C ambient/<=25ms VDD ramp constraints, and requires parent/owner selection.
